attackers_goals: Obtaining persistency by using a Lambda function in the target's environment as a backdoor.
description: A cloud identity has granted external AWS account sensitive permissions to a Lambda function.
investigative_actions: Investigate any unusual activity originating from the suspected identity. Investigate any unusual Lambda functions related operations originating from the allowed added accounts. Validate the legitimacy of the AWS accounts that were allowed external access.
